title: General Starbird leaves Johnston Island hours after Bluegill Triple Prime

tellings.quote: Operation Dominic. Ogle writes that General Starboard left Johnston Island at 4:00 a.m. the night of Operation Bluegill Triple Prime.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes Operation Dominic, a 1962 series of US nuclear tests in the Pacific, and one test in it called Bluegill Triple Prime. He says a man named William Ogle wrote that General Alfred Starbird, a senior Army officer, left Johnston Island, the small island used for the tests, at 4 a.m. that night, and he credits the logs of a Navy ship, the USS Summit County. Michels tells it because, if true, a sudden departure that night might hint something unusual happened during the test.
